title: How to Properly Dispose of Sanitary Napkins
steps: Wrap used sanitary napkins in tissue paper or biodegradable wrappers.
Place the wrapped napkins in a sealed plastic bag to prevent odors and leakage.
Dispose of them in regular household garbage bins.
Do not flush sanitary napkins down the toilet as they can cause blockages.
Educate family members on proper disposal practices to prevent environmental contamination.
Consider using reusable sanitary products to reduce waste.
Spread awareness on the importance of sanitary waste management.
precautions: Keep sanitary napkins out of reach of children and pets.
Avoid throwing sanitary napkins in compost bins.
Ensure proper wrapping to prevent exposure to germs.
Do not mix sanitary waste with recycling streams.
